meta.name: add-webex
meta.description: Add Webex channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 在应用中集成Webex聊天频道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在应用里接入Webex聊天功能。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Webex chat into your app.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Webex chat to your app.

howto.what: 把 Webex 渠道适配器从 channels 分支复制进 src/channels/，追加注册导入、安装固定版本依赖 @bitbasti/chat-adapter-webex@0.1.0，然后构建并运行注册测试。机器人凭据需要你手动创建后写入 .env。
howto.when: 当你要给 NanoClaw 添加 Webex 渠道集成时使用，例如在 /setup 流程中或之后，再运行 /manage-channels 把它接到 agent group。

say.text: 帮我给 NanoClaw 加上 Webex 渠道
say.note: 复制适配器、注册导入、装依赖并跑测试

say.text: Webex 发送消息一直报 401，帮我排查
say.note: 检查是否误用了 12 小时个人令牌

say.text: 把 Webex 渠道接到我的 agent group

howto.what_en: Copies the Webex adapter from the channels branch into src/channels/, appends the registration import, installs @bitbasti/chat-adapter-webex@0.1.0, then builds and runs the registration test. You supply the bot token and webhook secret.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to add a Webex channel to NanoClaw, e.g. during or after /setup, then run /manage-channels to wire it to an agent group.

say_en.text: Add Webex support to NanoClaw for me
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, registers it, installs deps, runs the test

say_en.text: My Webex sends keep failing with 401, help me debug
say_en.note: Checks whether the 12-hour personal token was used

say_en.text: Wire the Webex channel to my agent group
